'''''Bloodsniffer''''' was a group of [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvettes]] sent to save the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Relentless (Sunaj IV)|''Relentless'']], although they were unable to stop [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]] from destroying it.
